answer: Answering is cheap; being ready is not. Each epoch the ledger fires a fresh puzzle at a random instant, seed-unique and serial, and grants voting weight only to identities that reply within a short window. A farmer parked on a sunny terrace with a thousand idle keys cannot pre-solve tomorrow's riddle; every echo of a reply must come from live compute devoted to one persona. Burn the ember of attention on all clones at once, or watch the unready seats cool to zero.
